status: ASSUMPTION A9f Fluxrelay turn/current exchange; NOT RUN

search.selection_rule: Among candidates that pass every inherited electrical band, minimize installed supplier power-module mass; then minimize the maximum normalized demand on reference energy, healthy 10% DC-link-margin voltage, fault 48 V voltage and 400 A phase current; then choose fewer turns.

scaling_rules.conductor_area: Area per turn = 10.4 mm2 * 4/N so total slot copper is unchanged
scaling_rules.field: MMF is held at 1520 A-turn; field is treated as unchanged for this screen and must be re-solved after selection
scaling_rules.machine_energy: With fixed MMF and copper volume, ideal winding I2R, magnetic energy, cage force/loss and core loss are held at the A9b non-inverter values for this screen
scaling_rules.voltage: A9b healthy and failed-cell link demands scale linearly with N/4 because resistive/load and L di/dt voltage both scale with the turn exchange
scaling_rules.local_bridge: One three-phase bridge is installed at every ABC module; three modules per face are active. Supplier bridge conduction scales with phase-current squared.
